name: Smart Campus Digital Twin
blurb: Real-time 3D digital twin of the University of Moratuwa campus, built as a microservices platform on Kubernetes with an MQTT to Kafka telemetry pipeline and ML forecasting services.
detail:
Sensor telemetry flows from MQTT (Mosquitto) through a validating ingest bridge into Apache Kafka, then fans out to a consumer writing time-series into InfluxDB with Flux downsampling tasks and relational state into PostgreSQL, with Redis caching and Alembic-managed migrations.

A FastAPI service exposes REST and WebSocket endpoints behind a Kong API gateway with Keycloak OIDC authentication. The Next.js 16 / React 19 frontend renders an interactive 3D campus in Three.js via react-three-fiber alongside live Recharts dashboards.

ML services forecast energy, library and canteen occupancy and detect sensor anomalies, with MLflow tracking experiments and a scheduled retraining daemon refreshing models automatically. A configurable simulator with anomaly injection drives load testing. Deployed GitOps-style via ArgoCD with Kustomize manifests, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Prometheus + Grafana observability.
